title: 第一卷 第7章 就那么想和他划分界线吗第一卷 第8章 我要二师兄陪我修炼
slug: 笨蛋美人当团宠师兄们抢疯了

;;
“你在哭。”
谢寒声当时意识模糊，隐约听见舒晩昭的哭声。
她就像是失去了什么重要的人，声声力竭，声声泣血。
谢寒声一直认为小师妹性格恶劣，从不把任何人放在心上。
甚至不断利用父母的死亡来警醒师尊，乃至整个宗门。
时刻提醒他们，是师尊欠了她父母一条命。
她肆无忌惮挥霍父母的恩情，几乎将父母的命挂在嘴边。
他以为，她是没有心的无情人。
可他倒下后才发现，小师妹好像没有他想象中那么坏。
至少，她没有在紧要关头，将他推开。
而是帮她挡住了魔气。
她不过是个缺爱的孩子罢了。
就如此时，和小刺猬一样，竖起浑身的刺做出攻击的样子，可实际上，那满身的刺下是柔软的肚皮，并非无懈可击，她也是会受伤。
谢寒声对她说：“师妹，在我面前，你不必伪装。”
比他矮上很多的姑娘眉毛一竖，看着他的表情凶凶的，“你瞎说，那还不是因为你死了师尊和大师兄得找我算账，不然我才懒得管你。”
“你没死，大师兄还打我呢。”说着说着，她把自己说委屈了，冲他冷哼，“都是因为你。”
谢寒声语气一沉，“他如何罚你？我去和他理论。”
说着，他抬步就要去找沈长安。
舒晩昭立即拦着他，“不要。”

开玩笑，打手板这种糗事才不要和他说呢，况且她还欠个挨鞭子的剧情，他要去找沈长安帮她解释，她不就洗白了？
“总之，不要你管，你要是过意不去，以后大师兄给你的驱魔丹都给我。”
谢寒声脚步顿住，无声看她焦急的脸。
她宁愿挨罚，也要将那日的事情真相掩埋。
就那么想和他划分界线吗？
舒晩昭不管他怎么想，见他眼珠黑沉沉的，幽暗冷冽，有几分吓人，心里也跟着发怵。可剧情里没有谢寒声没有魔化之前，想要在宗门里面待着，就不会对她动手。
就在舒晩昭大脑疯狂思考的时候，男人不知是不是妥协了，淡淡地应了一声：“好。”
她松了一口气，猫猫祟祟偷瞄他的脸色。
他恢复了面无表情的死人脸，让人看不出什么想法，只是房间内的氛围很是压抑，她不愿多待，又“凶”了他两句，便灰溜溜跑走。
徒留男人沉默地站在原地，阳光透过窗棂的影子照射在他身上，将他孤寂的身影拉扯。
谁都不曾发现，他身后的影子中，似有似无的黑气暗中涌动……
而他的眼中，有一抹猩红转瞬即逝，快得仿佛是错觉。
--
欺负完谢寒声，舒晩昭回到自己院子里，大师兄还在忙，一时半会儿没来鸡娃她。
这是她穿越到这里，难得有的一段喘息时光。
路过的弟子看见她，隔老远就绕道走了，也不知道原主造了多大的孽，人见人愁，狗见狗嫌。
不过还是有人愿意和她交流的，就像是现代学院里面拉帮结派的人，有些弟子就算不喜欢原主，也碍于原主的身份和她结交。
师尊虽然散养，可出手却很大方，她的储物袋里林林总总的法器都不错，上次吸引魔气的琉璃火，就是用来淬炼灵力的火种，还可以用来炼丹。

"You're crying."
Xie Hansheng was unconscious at the time and could vaguely hear Shu Mizhao crying.
She seemed to have lost someone important, crying at the top of her lungs and crying blood.
Xie Hansheng always thought that the junior sister had a bad character and never took anyone seriously.
He even continued to use the death of his parents to warn his master and even the entire sect.
Always remind them that Master owes her parents their lives.
She unscrupulously squandered her parents' kindness and almost put their parents' lives on the line.
He thought she was a heartless heartless person.
But after he fell, he realized that the junior sister was not as bad as he thought.
At least, she didn't push him away at the critical moment.
Instead, he helped her block the evil spirit.
She is just a child who lacks love.
At this moment, like a little hedgehog, she raised her thorns all over her body as if to attack, but in fact, under the thorns all over her body was a soft belly, which was not invulnerable, and she would be injured.
Xie Hansheng said to her: "Junior sister, you don't have to pretend in front of me."
The girl who was much shorter than him raised her eyebrows and looked at him with a ferocious expression. "You're talking nonsense. That's because the master and senior brother have to settle accounts with me if you die. Otherwise, I wouldn't bother to care about you."
"You're not dead, but Senior Brother still beats me." As she spoke, she said she felt wronged and snorted at him, "It's all because of you."
Xie Hansheng's tone dropped, "How will he punish you? I'll argue with him."
With that said, he stepped up to find Shen Changan.
Shu Mingzhao immediately stopped him, "No."
Just kidding, don't tell him about embarrassing things like spanking. Besides, she still needs to be whipped. If he wants to find Shen Changan to explain to her, won't she be cleared?
"Anyway, don't worry about it. If you feel bad about it, give me all the exorcism pills that senior brother gives you in the future."
Xie Hansheng paused and silently looked at her anxious face.
She would rather be punished than bury the truth of what happened that day.
Do you really want to set a boundary with him?
No matter what he thought, Shu Mingzhao felt frightened when he saw that his eyes were dark, dark and cold, a bit scary. But there is no plot in the plot. Before Xie Hansheng was demonized, if she wanted to stay in the sect, she would not do anything to her.
Just when Shu Mingzhao was thinking crazily, the man didn't know if he had compromised or not, and responded calmly: "Okay."
She breathed a sigh of relief, and the cat glanced at his face furtively.
He returned to his dead expressionless face, which made it impossible to tell what he was thinking, but the atmosphere in the room was very depressing. She didn't want to stay any longer, so she said "severely" to him and ran away in despair.
The man was left standing silently, the sunlight shining on him through the shadow of the window lattice, pulling his lonely figure.
No one noticed that in the shadow behind him, there was a vague black energy surging secretly...
And in his eyes, there was a flash of scarlet that disappeared so quickly that it seemed like an illusion.
--
After bullying Xie Hansheng, Shu Mingzhao returned to his yard. The senior brother was still busy and did not come to Jiwa for a while.
This was a rare moment of respite for her after traveling here.
The disciples who were passing by saw her and took a detour a long way away. They didn't know how much evil the original owner had done. Everyone was sad when they saw her, and dogs were disgusted when they saw her.
However, there are still people who are willing to communicate with her, just like the cliques in modern colleges. Even if some disciples don't like the original owner, they still want to befriend her because of the original owner's identity.
Although the master lives a free life, she is very generous with her actions. The various magic weapons in her storage bag are all good. The glazed fire that attracted the demonic energy last time is the kind of fire used to temper spiritual power and can also be used to make elixirs.
